notes: Parent holding company. Form-text 'Citi Group' (two words) is non-standard spacing; resolves to Citigroup, Inc. per Fork F §4 Decision Q5. Note: the lender of record on a U.S. mortgage or line of credit is typically Citibank, N.A. (the operating bank subsidiary), not the holding company; per Q5 the default to parent stands unless form context specifies otherwise. Counterparty on Jared 2018 (item 6), Jared 2019 (item 4), and Ivanka NE (item 6).
